capabilities: sync Discord channel messages into Markdown files
store messages as individual, daily, weekly, or monthly logs
clip web pages to Markdown via !url command
send sync completion notifications to Discord
trigger sync on launch or via command palette
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; README warns against sending sensitive information through Discord. The !url clipping command is marked under development.
problem: Messages captured in Discord stay in Discord; there is no built-in way to turn them into vault notes.

requires.name: Discord Developer Portal app with bot token

summary: Discord bot integration that syncs channel messages into Markdown notes and clips web pages via a !url command.
